'''Perystal''' was the name of a fictional [[dragon]] character in the children's [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] ''[[Castle Creep]]''. Around [[43 ABY]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian's]] son [[Lando Calrissian, Junior|Lando Calrissian Jr.]] owned a toy of Perystal.
